name: Clay Mascot 3D
description: Soft clay 3D format with a persistent mascot: a custom character pinned to a screen corner that follows the camera, a pastel mesh-gradient backdrop, soft wide shadows and clay materials. The 3D layer for tips, rules and checklists (a 2D UI-card video can sit on top). A format, not a scene: the agent designs the mascot and the props from scratch for each video. No emoji.
prompt_hint: 6-10 scenes (3-5 s). Each: title.kicker + title.main, visual.type "scene3d" with the SAME custom mascot object (`corner` bl or br, a face with blink and wave motion) in every scene plus one custom prop or two that illustrate the tip, and a `world` (ground plane or disc, soft backdrop). Add a `stat` for a counter like 3 / 10. No emoji.
